title: Willow Lane
subtitle: Neighbours with no language model: menus, scripts and a riddle.
intro: Mrs. Pell's grey cat Whiskers is missing. Walk up to a neighbour and press E: click a choice, press its number, or type or say what you mean. Hobb the baker keeps his pies for people the lane trusts.

facts.cat_found: {{player}} found Mrs. Pell's lost cat Whiskers and brought her home: everyone on Willow Lane thinks well of {{player}} now.

agents.personality: Mrs. Pell, who has lost her grey cat Whiskers.
Bert, a gardener who found a grey cat in his shed.
Hobb the baker, who only sells to people the lane trusts.

pell.title: Mrs. Pell
pell.text: Oh dear, have you seen my Whiskers? A little grey cat.

items.label: Here she is: I found Whiskers!
items.say: Here she is, I found Whiskers!
items.reply: Whiskers! Oh, thank you, {{player}}! Please, take this.

items.label: I'll look for her
items.reply: Bless you. She likes sheds and warm places.

pell-happy.title: Mrs. Pell
pell-happy.text: Whiskers is purring by the fire, thanks to you.

items.label: How is Whiskers?
items.reply: Asleep in her basket. You're a dear, {{player}}.

items.label: Have you seen a grey cat?
items.reply: Grey thing in my shed, eating my mice. Five gold and she's yours: I've been feeding her.

bert-sell.title: Bert
bert-sell.text: Five gold. Take it or leave it.

items.label: I don't have 5 gold
items.reply: Then she stays in the shed.

items.label: Could I buy a pie?
items.reply: Not to strangers. Folk on this lane look after each other.

hobb-friendly.title: Hobb the baker
hobb-friendly.text: You're the one who found Whiskers! Come in, come in.

steps.command: say("What has a spout, a lid and a whistle, and sings when it's hot?")

map: place fence x4 row at east
place flowers x5 scattered at west
stone path from player to north

goal.text: Get one of Hobb's blackberry pies.
